relationships.subject: Didymin
relationships.evidence_quote: It decreased NLRP3, ASC, GSDMD, and phosphorylated NF-κB levels, while enhancing RKIP expression.

relationships.subject: Didymin
relationships.evidence_quote: Didymin ameliorates neuropathic pain by promoting RKIP expression and suppressing NF-κB/NLRP3-mediated pyroptosis and neuroinflammation.

relationships.subject: Didymin
relationships.evidence_quote: Molecular docking and dynamics confirmed stable binding between Didymin and RKIP.

relationships.subject: Locostatin
relationships.evidence_quote: The protective effects were abolished by Locostatin, confirming RKIP dependence.

key_findings: Didymin alleviates CCI mechanical allodynia via RKIP-dependent suppression of NF-κB/NLRP3 pyroptosis.
